use_case_summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS. Primary goal: in-app AI assistant for product support and guided discovery, plus embeddings-backed document search and reranking for personalized help. Must preserve sub-200ms interactive p99 for short flows; tolerate higher latency for long generations. Cost-sensitive but values predictable throughput and data isolation for customer data.
hosted_trial_metrics: 2-week hosted API trial: total requests 58k, avg QPS 6, peak QPS 47, avg tokens/request 240, request mix = 35% short (<=64t), 45% medium (65-256t), 20% long (>256t). Observed p50 95ms, p95 280ms when caching cold; continuous-batching reduced cost by ~12% on trial endpoints.
traffic_forecast_assumptions: Team expects 3-6x growth in 6 months post-launch. Baseline forecast for Dedicated sizing: steady-state avg QPS 18, bursts to 80 QPS during feature release windows; target concurrency 60. Monthly token forecast (conservative): 270M tokens; optimistic: 540M tokens.
dedicated_capacity_recommendation: Redwood initial recommendation: Dedicated pool sized for bursts (80 QPS, concurrency 60) — baseline: 4 x A10G-equivalent GPUs (or 2 x H100-equivalent for customers wanting lower latency per-device) with autoscale to 8 GPUs for peak. Include 2x redundancy for rolling upgrades. Expect unit economics: ~ $X/token using quantized 8-bit profiles; final pricing to be in pricing_v2.xlsx.
sizing_breakdown_quick_notes:
- Concurrency target 60 based on 80 QPS and avg 240 token outputs (generation bound).
- Recommend KV/prefix caching for repeated help articles — estimated 18% token savings.
- Plan to start with 4-GPU pool and enable burst autoscale to 8 for 4 weeks after launch to validate.
